All You Need to Know About AGENTIC X 2.0 – AI & Robotics Hackathon | Future Tech Summit ’26

AGENTIC X 2.0 is an AI & Robotics Hackathon held as part of Future Tech Summit ’26, organized by the AI Research Centre (AIRC), Woxsen University, in collaboration with Gentricks and TruScholar.

The hackathon brings together innovators, developers, students, and technology enthusiasts to build creative solutions to real-world challenges through Artificial Intelligence, Agentic AI, Robotics, and Autonomous Systems.

Hackathon Tracks

Track 1 – Software: Agentic AI

  • Theme: Autonomous Intelligence for the Digital World
  • Problem Statement: Autonomous AI Agents for Intelligent Real-World Decision-Making
  • Participants can develop innovative software solutions using AI agents, multi-agent systems, reasoning, planning, large language models (LLMs), intelligent copilots, and workflow automation.

Track 2 – Hardware: Robotics & Autonomous Systems

  • Theme: Intelligent Machines for the Physical World
  • Problem Statement: Intelligent Autonomous Machines for Real-World Physical Challenges
  • Participants can explore robotics, autonomous systems, embedded AI, sensors, computer vision, the Internet of Things (IoT), control systems, and intelligent machines.

Competition Process

  • Round 1 – Idea / Prototype Submission
  • Registration Fee: FREE
  • Round 1 Deadline: Friday, 27 November 2026, 11:59 PM IST
  • Shortlist Announcement: Wednesday, 2 December 2026
  • Participants register through Unstop and submit their idea or prototype presentation (PPT) for evaluation.

Submission guidelines:

  • One submission per team, for one track only
  • PPT only, maximum 10 slides
  • Clearly state the problem, proposed solution, technology stack, feasibility and technical approach, potential impact, and current stage — idea-only, prototype in progress, or working prototype
  • For Track 2, idea-only entries are accepted in Round 1. A working prototype is not mandatory in Round 1, but if you have one, include photos, a short demo video link, or test results.
  • Submissions must be original work by the team.

Submissions will be evaluated based on:

  • Innovation and originality
  • Problem relevance
  • Feasibility and technical approach
  • Potential impact
  • Quality of the proposed solution

Shortlisted teams will qualify for Round 2.

Round 2 – Final Build & Demo

  • Shortlisted teams will advance to the in-person final round at Woxsen University, Hyderabad. Participants will develop or refine their solutions and present their final build or demonstration to the judges.
  • The full Round 2 schedule and participation details will be shared directly with shortlisted teams.
  • Hardware teams should bring their prototype and components. If you need power, workspace, or internet support for your demo, inform the organizers in advance after shortlisting.

Internship Opportunities

  • Internship Opportunities for Hackathon Winners!
  • Winning teams will be considered for internship opportunities with startups and AI research centres, providing a chance to gain practical experience, showcase their technical skills, and explore opportunities within the startup ecosystem.
  • Exclusive Benefit for Hackathon Participants
  • Free Access to All Technical Talks at Future Tech Summit ’26!
  • Participants who register for AGENTIC X 2.0 will receive free access to all technical talks at Future Tech Summit ’26, giving them the opportunity to learn from industry experts and explore emerging technologies. This benefit covers technical talks only.

Eligibility

The hackathon welcomes students, freshers, professionals, and technology enthusiasts interested in AI, robotics, and emerging technologies.

Team size: 1–4 members per team (a team leader plus up to 3 members).

Relevant fields include:

Computer Science and Engineering
Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
Data Science
Electronics and Communication Engineering
Robotics and Autonomous Systems
Other engineering and technology-related disciplines

Event Details

  • Hackathon: AGENTIC X 2.0 – AI & Robotics Hackathon
  • Hackathon Date: 9 December 2026
  • Future Tech Summit ’26: 8–9 December 2026
  • Round 1: Online Idea/Prototype PPT Submission
  • Round 1 Registration Fee: FREE
  • Round 1 Deadline: Friday, 17 November 2026, 11:59 PM IST
  • Shortlist Announcement: Wednesday, 2 December 2026
  • Round 2: In-person Final Build & Demo
  • Venue: Woxsen University, Hyderabad, Telangana, India
  • Event website: fts.aircwou.in
  • Updates: @gentricks__

Travel and Stay: Participants are responsible for their own travel to Woxsen University, Hyderabad. Accommodation and on-campus logistics details for shortlisted teams will be shared after shortlisting.

Why Participate?

  • Build innovative solutions across AI and robotics.
  • Showcase your ideas and technical abilities.
  • Compete with aspiring innovators and technology enthusiasts.
  • Get free access to all technical talks at Future Tech Summit ’26.
  • Be considered for internship opportunities as a winning team.
